scope: Every input used by an execution in results/ (plus inputs referenced only by attempts that never executed, with executions_using = 0). No media bytes are stored here; regenerate them and verify by SHA-256.
excluded_inputs: Live Camera2 captures and the UVG / SVT natural clips (not redistributable) are not part of this baseline; runs that used them are excluded.

inputs.licence: LibriSpeech test-clean utterances CC BY 4.0 (c) 2014 Vassil Panayotov; LibriVox German/Spanish public domain; Open Goldberg Variations (Kimiko Ishizaka) CC0. Full notices: benchmarks/inputs/speech-v1/README.md in the app repository.
inputs.how_to_obtain: Committed in the app repository at benchmarks/inputs/speech-v1/speech-v1-20s.wav. Rebuild and verify from the committed sources with: python -B tools/build_speech_reference.py verify --sources benchmarks/inputs/speech-v1/sources --build benchmarks/inputs/speech-v1 (needs tools/requirements-audio.txt).
inputs.pairs_with: 20 s native video loops (coverage, quick-mosaic recipes)
